inputs.title: Magnetic map of chi1 Ori from 16 polarised spectra of 20 December 2014 to 30 December 2014: radial, azimuthal and meridional field on a longitude-latitude grid
inputs.credit: CFHT ESPaDOnS, CFHT program 14BF09, from the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre; reduced and mapped in this project with Korg 1.3.1, LSDpy 1.0.0, specpolFlow 1.1.0, ZDIpy. This research used the facilities of the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre operated by the National Research Council of Canada with the support of the Canadian Space Agency.
inputs.acquisition: The file the chi1-orionis package holds for its own dataset radial-field-2014-12; Written by packages/telescope-cli/src/archives/espadons/reduce.mts with the program chi1-ori-2014-12, which pins every archived spectrum by its size. The run's receipt (the line list, the codes and each step's result) is written again by that command under output/espadons and is not kept in git.
inputs.license: CC BY 4.0 for the archived spectra (Canadian Astronomy Data Centre); reduction by this project
